rfam.comment: By using various computational and experimental approaches in three Pyrococcus genomes seven H/ACA sRNAs and 15 pseudouridine resides on rRNA were identified. One H/ACA motif was shown to guide up to three distinct pseudouridylations [1]. The structure of Pab160 RNA in complex with ribonucleoprotein pseudouridine synthase was reported in [2].
